2125391380038230058.en_summary: (Reposted by @JohnSpall247) Greg Brockman (@gdb) says ChatGPT Ads are opening up the playing field for smaller brands to compete, quoting Similarweb analysis that ChatGPT is emerging as an advertising channel where smaller brands have an opportunity against established players.
2125391380038230058.zh_summary: （由 @JohnSpall247 轉推）Greg Brockman（@gdb）表示 ChatGPT 廣告正在為較小品牌開闢競爭空間，引用 Similarweb 分析指出 ChatGPT 正成為廣告渠道，讓較小品牌有機會與已建立的玩家競爭。

2125390712795488550.en_summary: Geiger_Capital notes Massachusetts let a fugitive illegal immigrant with a deportation order win the lottery, saying we are living in a South Park episode. Quoted BillMelugin_ reporting ICE Boston arrested the $1 million Massachusetts State Lottery winner, a Salvadoran illegal alien and wanted ICE fugitive with deportation order since 2014.
2125390712795488550.zh_summary: Geiger_Capital 指出麻薩諸塞州讓一名有遞解令的逃犯非法移民中了彩票，稱我們活在《南方公園》情節中。引用 BillMelugin_ 報道 ICE 波士頓辦公室逮捕了麻薩諸塞州彩票 100 萬美元得主，一名薩爾瓦多非法移民及自 2014 年起有遞解令的通緝逃犯。

2125386322294764031.en_summary: Jason offers to send two investigative journalists for @ThisWeeknAI to work on projects. Quoted CillianCrosson noting NYT investigation into Jensen Huang, and Tarbell funding more investigative journalism into AI companies like Anthropic, OpenAI, Nvidia with grants $50-500k, open call closing Dec 11.
2125386322294764031.zh_summary: Jason 表示可為 @ThisWeeknAI 派遣兩名調查記者工作。引用 CillianCrosson 提及《紐約時報》對黃仁勳的調查，以及 Tarbell 有意資助更多針對 Anthropic、OpenAI、Nvidia 等 AI 公司的調查新聞，資助額通常 5 萬至 50 萬美元，公開徵集於 12 月 11 日截止。

2125384190279749663.en_summary: Ross__Hendricks comments on discussion of pardons for Jensen Huang, questioning if Huang did nothing wrong. Quoted TheInsiderPaper reporting Trump says he is willing to pardon Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang if necessary but believes he won’t need one and should tell the truth when testifying before Congress next week.
2125384190279749663.zh_summary: Ross__Hendricks 評論有關赦免黃仁勳的討論，質疑黃仁勳是否真的沒做錯事。引用 TheInsiderPaper 報道特朗普表示若有必要願意赦免 Nvidia 行政總裁黃仁勳，但相信無需如此，並應在下週國會作證時說實話。
